name: Allows a user to reset their forgotten password and regain access to their account. - Basic Flow (Happy Path)
preconditions: User is on the login page.

steps.description: The User requests a Password Reset Link from the System.
steps.expectedResult: System has received a request for a password reset link with an email address.

steps.description: The System sends a Password Reset Link to the User's email address.
steps.expectedResult: Password Reset Link sent to User's email; Password Reset Link is valid for 30 minutes.

steps.description: The User clicks the received Password Reset Link, which directs them to the System.
steps.expectedResult: User is on the new password entry form.

steps.description: The User enters and confirms a new password for their Account to the System.
steps.expectedResult: System has received a new Password that meets complexity rules.

steps.description: The System invalidates the Password Reset Link and all active Login Sessions for the Account, then displays a confirmation message to the User.
steps.businessObject: Password Reset Link, Login Session, Account
steps.expectedResult: Password Reset Link is invalidated; All Login Sessions for the Account are invalidated; Confirmation message displayed to User; User can log in with the new Password.

expectedPostconditions: All Login Sessions for the Account are invalidated
User can log in with the new Password.
